_comment: Streets whose OSM ways lack name:etymology:wikidata but where we are confident of the namesake. osm_fixes.py lists the ways that still lack the tag (it re-reads OSM when generating OSM_FIXES.md).

suggestions.label: Koninklijke Philips N.V. (the company)
suggestions.reason: the road in Maarheeze heads toward the A2 and the Eindhovenseweg, i.e. toward Eindhoven, where Philips was headquartered; the buurt is an industrial estate (Den Engelsman/Rondven). One way was already tagged by the OSM contributor on 2026-11-21.

suggestions.label: Anton Philips (the person)
suggestions.reason: the name is Anton Philips's (Anton Philipslaan streets elsewhere already carry Q592767).

other_ways.where: Maarheeze area, just outside our Noord-Brabant data (the roads continue across the border; ~51.28-51.29 N, 5.645-5.665 E)
other_ways.label: Anton Philips (the person)
other_ways.reason: same road, tagged Q592767 by the OSM contributor on 2026-11-21 (way 268417255); the other ways of the road carry no etymology tag. Also untagged: Anton Philipsweg ways 47981476/47981492/338519956 are already Q592767; the Anton Philipsweg ways in Noord-Holland/Utrecht (7368144, 7432917, 120495713, 331977059, 437414872, 1147000196, 1244959494) carry none.
